comment: Bundled T5 ladder (build 10): ANE cells FIRST (the product path), cpuOnly cells LAST. Plain cpuOnly 6-bit cells are refused before loading by the fp16-dequant memory preflight (≈7.25 GiB fresh + margin > headroom); the one forced cell at the end (force:true) overrides it to run the decisive test — crash = hypothesis A confirmed, the cursor stops the loop. Same protocol as Documents/auto.json, which still wins if pushed. Runs once; relaunch is blocked by Documents/auto_default.done.
